blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A pending petition before the Supreme Court challenging the jurisdiction of a Quezon City court has prompted another postponement of Vice President Sara Duterte’s arraignment on three counts of grave threats on Friday, Oct. 9. Duterte’s lawyer, Paul Laurence Lim, said the Quezon City Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 98, presided over by Judge Maria Angelica de Ramos, considered the defense’s petition for certiorari before the high court and its pending motion for partial reconsideration ad cautelam before canceling the scheduled arraignment. “Today was supposed to be the arraignment but we have pending motions,” Lim said in an […]...
